about: Second held-out intent set. Written AFTER the stemming and first-person fixes in lib/services/intent_router.dart were frozen, and the rules were not modified in response to the result. This exists because held_out_intent_queries.json is now burned: it revealed two general bugs (no plural stemming, first person detected from an enumerated phrase list) and the fixes for those were informed by it, so its score is no longer a clean measurement. This file is the clean one. If it is ever used to tune the rules, it must be retired the same way and a third set written.
